**[SER](https://www.sergroup.com/en/)**, a Bonn, Germany-based intelligent content automation (“ICA”) software vendor in the enterprise content management (“ECM”) market, received an investment from TA Associates.

The amount off the deal was not disclosed.

The company intends to use the funds to expand operations and development efforts.

Led by CEO Dr. John Bates, SER provides an intelligent content automation (ICA) platform, which leverages AI to provide intelligent content understanding and process automation. Its Doxis platform brings ICA capabilities into a single, unified platform that works across multiple applications and vendor ecosystems, such as SAP, Salesforce and Microsoft.

Today, SER has over 600 employees across 20 offices in 11 countries. The company’s technology is used by blue-chip enterprise customers worldwide.
